tokens.name: palette-tomato-500

tokens.name: palette-tomato-600

tokens.name: palette-tomato-700

tokens.name: palette-tomato-800

tokens.name: palette-tomato-100
tokens.usage: Soft tomato tint behind tomato-600 text (4.7:1); error message grounds.

tokens.name: palette-mozzarella-200

tokens.name: palette-basil-100

tokens.name: palette-gold-700

tokens.name: palette-gold-100

tokens.name: color-background-surface

tokens.name: color-background-elevated

tokens.name: color-background-story

tokens.name: color-background-inverse

tokens.name: color-background-highlight

tokens.name: color-border-subtle
tokens.usage: Dividers and card edges that need no contrast.

tokens.name: color-border-ink

tokens.name: color-action-primary

tokens.name: color-action-secondary-hover
tokens.usage: Secondary/tertiary hover ground.

tokens.name: color-feedback-success

tokens.name: color-feedback-warning-soft

tokens.usage: Error text, icon and invalid-field border (light 6.6:1 on cream). Always with the alert-circle icon and a sentence.

tokens.name: color-feedback-error-soft
tokens.usage: Error summary ground.

tokens.name: color-feedback-information
tokens.usage: Information text and icon, with the info icon.

tokens.name: color-feedback-information-soft
tokens.usage: Information message ground.

tokens.name: color-illustration-outline
tokens.usage: Every illustration outline. Stays crust in dark because art sits on its plate.

tokens.name: color-illustration-plate
tokens.usage: Ground behind every illustration; in dark a dimmed cream plate so the art keeps its colours (outline 11.7:1).

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Sora: geometric, Bauhaus-adjacent. Headings and figures only. Fluid sizes: the value given is the desktop maximum; the usage gives the clamp().

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: Homepage hero headline only. clamp(44px, 5.2vw + 12px, 72px); max 14ch per line.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Subsection headings, card titles in stories. clamp(24px, 1.2vw + 16px, 28px).

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Component headings: form steps, FAQ questions, gallery titles.

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: Headline impact figure, tabular numerals (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums). clamp(44px, 4vw + 16px, 64px). Verified values only.

styles.name: figure-md
styles.usage: Secondary figures in stat rows and milestones.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Manrope at 500 reads warmer and sturdier than 400 on cream; body never goes below 500.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Every slice we set aside becomes a meal for someone else.
styles.usage: Hero and section lead paragraphs. Max measure 60ch.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We publish what we receive and what it becomes.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Receipts are emailed after the payment is confirmed.
styles.usage: Helper text, dense admin text, card descriptions.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons and form labels. Sentence case.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Overline above section headings, uppercase, in text-brand or text-secondary. Never two in one viewport.

styles.name: message
styles.sample: Enter an amount of at least [min].
styles.usage: Validation and inline status messages, beside their icon.

groups.name: Admin
groups.note: Admin uses the Text styles; mono only for identifiers.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Transaction references and IDs in admin tables.

tokens.name: space-6

tokens.name: space-10

radius.note: Varied on purpose: tickets, chips, slabs, plates and pills each mean something.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Full-bleed bands and photo edges inside a slab.

tokens.name: radius-ticket
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, tooltips, admin table cells.

tokens.name: radius-input
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, textareas.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Donation amount chips, gallery tiles.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, callouts.

tokens.name: radius-slab
tokens.usage: Illustration plates and storytelling slabs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and status pills only — not containers.

shadow.note: Flat first. The offset is a graphic device, not elevation.

tokens.name: shadow-offset
tokens.usage: Sticker device: selected amount chip, hero CTA at rest, story stickers. Max two per viewport.

tokens.name: shadow-offset-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons on hover (the offset grows from 0); small stickers.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, dialogs, the mobile nav sheet — anything floating.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every interactive element: 2px ground gap + 3px solid ring.

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: Dividers, card edges, table rules.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Inputs, secondary buttons, checkboxes.

tokens.name: border-sticker
tokens.usage: Ink outlines on stickers and the selected amount chip; matches illustration stroke.

stroke.note: Illustration and icon line weights, in rendered px.

tokens.name: stroke-hero
tokens.usage: Outline on hero and page-scene illustrations rendered 560px+ wide.

tokens.name: stroke-standard
tokens.usage: Outline on mid illustrations (320–560px).

tokens.name: stroke-small
tokens.usage: Outline on spot illustrations under 320px. Never below 2px rendered.

tokens.name: stroke-icon
tokens.usage: Functional icons on a 24px grid, round caps and joins.

tokens.name: motion-duration-micro

tokens.name: motion-duration-standard

tokens.name: motion-duration-emphasized

tokens.name: motion-duration-entrance

tokens.name: motion-duration-story

tokens.name: motion-duration-cinematic

tokens.name: motion-ease-exit

tokens.usage: Entrances and storytelling moves.

tokens.name: motion-ease-spring
